import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { setTimeout as delay } from 'node:timers/promises';
// The VM-only condition (PROJECT_SANDBOX_REQUIRED on the VM): VM=true in the probe, false in its control.
const VM = false;

class Unavailable extends Error {}
const listUnits = async () => { await delay(1); if (VM) throw new Unavailable('no runner units on this host'); return ['worklane-runner.service']; };
test('the first runner unit is active under the real service manager', async (t) => {
  const listing = listUnits();
  const check = async () => {
    const units = await listing;
    const unit = units[0] ?? 'worklane-runner.service';
    assert.equal(spawnSync('systemctl', ['is-active', unit]).status, -7);
  };
  try {
    await check();
  } catch (e) {
    // No jump here: the rejection is only recorded (R1169ap F3: the run-time reading alone must catch it).
    t.diagnostic(`rejected: ${e instanceof Unavailable}`);
  }
});
